venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.weather: Overcast and hot, highs in the 90s
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Friday 8/21 (MOD: MKZ // JK)** Net sales $7,336 against a $5,615 target (131%). Food $393, events $0, comps $64.50 (employee, F&F, industry, manager). 247 guests at a $29.70 check average. Overcast, hot day may have muted the open; guest flow picked up at 7pm and stayed steady-busy most of the night. Team ran short-staffed for late-night after Jayden was sent home around 10pm (no longer with CC ATL) — Dan, Tre, Mia & Keyshawn stepped up and MOD stayed to close. A modest pop after 10pm but no usual 12–12:30am neighborhood influx; space clear by 2am. Staff requested Narcan be kept on hand for emergencies. Kitchen stayed on top of tickets and helped FOH. No incidents; no-shows not charged.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Friday 8/21 (MOD: KE, JMS)** Net sales $10,286 against a $9,966 target (103%). Food $416, comps $87.95 (0.9%). 349 guests at a $29.47 check average. Slower for a Friday — students returned to school this week and other bars around town report a similarly slow week — but still beat target with pops around 9 and 11. Charmers has started intentionally sending guests over as part of their last-call protocol. Regulars from Opti plus Tiffany and friends (pro diners who post about visits on IG). Kitchen smooth; low Montenegro. No incidents; no-shows not charged.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Friday 8/21 (AM: Maggie; PM: Carey)** Total net sales including events $31,384.19 against a $20,250 target (155%). DC/AM $1,463.77, D&C PM $13,513.37, in-outlet net $15,116.19; net event sales $16,268 with $1,060 event food. Total food including events $13,521.60. Comps $955.39 (6.38%); 400 guests (Tock). Super busy Lobby shift with all other spaces occupied by events — big Lobby hits at the end of each event. Event 1: Noah Medical cocktail reception, 80+ guests, 8–11pm in Vauxhall and the Garden; buffet and passed apps crushed. Event 2: welcome party for Molly & David, 30+ guests, 8–10pm in Suite 6A; Minsu crushed bar service, wedding tomorrow. Report's day-of-week field said Saturday but this is the Friday 8/21 report (posted overnight). No incidents; no-shows not charged.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Friday 8/21 (MOD: Kyler / Steves)** Net sales $8,021 against an $8,149 target (98%). Food $672, beverage $7,349, events $0, comps $83.62. 241 guests (SevenRooms) at a $33 reported check average. Smooth flow with a slow, conclusive fizzle at the end despite hitting $8k. Room about 2/3 full by 6:45pm, full by 8pm with a waitlist from 8:30pm (mostly two-tops, never over 90 minutes), full on walk-ups until 1am. Top sellers: Paper Wasp / Rosalie (tie), Shinebox. Owner of Silent H (Toronto) visited ahead of a Meatpacking District opening in September; 4 birthdays and 1 anniversary celebrated. One no-show (charged). Breakage: 2 DOF, 1 wine, 1 pilsner, 1 egg coupe.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Friday 8/21 (MOD: Joe + Gigi / Josh + Oscar + Saleh)** Net sales $12,250 against an $11,846 target (103%). Standing Room $2,430 ($324 food), Marquee $9,803 ($1,749 food); total food $2,089, events $0. Comps $350.26 (members, investors, employee discounts, one spill, only 4 DNLs). 307 guests. Sleepy start with sporadic pops; little action until 8:30, then a ~50-person waitlist by 9:30 as everyone arrived at once. Many large parties couldn't be accommodated but lots of 2- and 3-tops seated. One table escorted out after a guest fell ill in the restroom. A challenging service — broken glasses, a frayed wire throwing sparks (repaired by Jorge), restroom messes, and a Tesla popping a tire outside — but the team pulled through. 86 tuna. No incidents; no-shows charged.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Friday 8/21 (MOD: Marcus / Josh)** Total net sales $7,376.36 against a $9,714 target (76%). Marquee bar $6,724.36, Garden $698, food $951, events $0. Comps $46 plus $214 in voids. 204 guests at a $36.34 GCA. Steady start with a healthy mix of reservations and walk-ins; bar top full most of the night with efficient floor rotation, then a hard lull from 10:45pm that never fully turned around. Garden was very slow despite perfect patio weather — last call there at 10pm and remaining guests moved to Marquee. Kitchen decent but many guests were coming from or going to dinner. Focus areas: vetting guests, wash lines, staying in motion. No incidents; no-shows not charged.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Friday 8/21 (AM: Braden & Sam / Shannon; PM: Justin / Sam & Shannon / Marcus / Drew)** Total net sales $11,398 against a $12,000 target (95%): Municipal Bar AM $1,110 (51 guests), PM $7,580 (191 guests), Sun Club $439, Hot Eye $2,176. Food $4,023, comps $456. A good big Friday for the restaurant — steady happy hour, dining room filled from 6pm, a walk-in group of SCAD professors took over the bar, large-party reservations after 8pm kept BOH cooking to close; largely cleared by 10:15pm. Hot Eye started very slow then packed out at 9:30 with another rush at midnight for the end of Brother Vinyl's set — local-heavy dance-floor crowd to close. Men's restroom leak/odor at Hot Eye put it out of order (work order placed); drip seemingly fixed mid-service but needs follow-up. Kitchen ran through mise but never 86'd. No incidents.
